description: Cosmic-scale beings that are neither Singulars, Nikes, Charles variants nor Harbingers. Narrative-only: none is bondable, catchable or purifiable, and none counts toward the 5,555.
rule: Nothing in this directory may be promoted to a Singular, given a purify path, or made larger in the story than Nolem. If a proposal needs one of those, it does not belong here.
whyNotDimensions: These records deliberately do NOT live in dimensions/. That directory is CI-checked by the dimensions-agree job, which asserts one detail file per index row — a non-dimension file there fails the build. Burying a cosmology-bearing entity inside a region record is also how register row W3 happened: the Dimension Eater was named in six shipped nodes and a database row and was invisible to a search of the bible.
